wiki.title: Sarah Drennan
wiki.extract: Sarah Drennan (born January 8, 1981) is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for the 20th district. She is the Assistant Majority Whip. She is also an NICU registered nurse. Drennan graduated from Marshall University-St. Mary's School of Nursing.
